title: OptimAI: Leveraging LLM-powered AI Agents for Solving Optimization Problems Described in Natural Language

defines.name: OptimAI
defines.definition: A multi-agent framework that solves optimization problems described in natural language by translating them into mathematical formulations and generating executable solution strategies with LLM-powered agents.

problem: Formulating natural-language optimization problems into mathematical models and selecting appropriate solvers requires substantial domain expertise, making optimization inaccessible to non-experts.
